system.flavor:
A chirp before the pickpocket's hand reaches your purse, a tug at the sleeve before a tile falls from the eaves, a hiss when the ground ahead is a snare, or a warning at the door before a knock lands. One small danger, seen one moment early.

Not enough to watch a whole street or warn you of what is still around the corner.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against the attack.

surges.html: Reveal the attacker's occupied space to the target.
After the attack, the target may move 1 unit.
